noCharacters: No characters yet. Create one here, or save one from the Subject step of the prompt builder.
deleteNote: Its images stay in History, no longer linked to {name}.
seedProblem: The seed must be a whole number from 0 to {max}, or empty.
name: Name
seedPlaceholder: Empty: a new seed each time
noFace: No face. Open an image of this character in History and choose {action} (a close crop of the face works best), or upload a photo. RealVisXL (in photo style), WAI-Illustrious and Anime Desire then keep that face.
copyingWarning: Above 80% the face image is copied, often with its pose and clothes, and most of the prompt is ignored. 50–65% usually keeps the face and follows the prompt.
photoNotImage: Choose an image file (JPEG, PNG or WebP).
photoTooLarge: The photo is larger than 10 MB; choose a smaller one.
photoUnreadable: The photo could not be read; try another one.
safeForWorkNote: An uploaded photo can show a real person, so images of {name} are kept safe for work: nude or sexual prompts are refused, the 18+ purposes are hidden in the prompt builder, and any image that comes out with nudity is discarded.
summaryNote: The face, hair and body come from this character. Change them on the Characters page, or pick “No character” in Create.
saveAsCharacterIntro: Keeps who they are, their face, hair and body, so every image of them matches.
problemNoAge: A character needs “Who” and an adult age range.
